title: Full-Stack Developer
summary: Build and ship the products and client sites that carry the New Machine name — from a Next.js marketing site to a full SaaS backend, end to end, with no layer of hand-off between you and production.
responsibilities: Ship features across the stack: React/Next.js front ends, Node/Python APIs, and the databases behind them
Own a project from technical spec through deploy — no separate QA or DevOps team to hand off to
Review architecture decisions with the founding team before they become expensive to undo
Keep client and internal products fast, accessible and maintainable, not just "working"
Pair with design and marketing to turn a Figma file or a rough idea into a shipped product
requirements: 3+ years shipping production web applications, ideally with TypeScript and a modern framework
Comfortable owning a feature end to end — API, database, UI — without a large team behind you
Can explain a technical trade-off in plain language to a non-technical founder or client
Genuinely curious about new tools, but not distracted by them — you finish what you start
Full overlap availability isn't required; async communication skills are

title: Product Designer — UI/UX & Brand
summary: Design the interfaces, brand systems and visual identity for every product and client site we touch — the person who decides whether something looks like a template or looks like New Machine.
responsibilities: Design end-to-end UI/UX for client websites, landing pages and internal products
Build and maintain design systems that scale across projects instead of starting from zero each time
Turn a client brief into a visual direction, then defend it with reasoning, not just taste
Run lightweight usability passes on shipped work and fold the findings back into the system
Collaborate directly with engineering on implementation — no redlines thrown over a wall
requirements: A portfolio that shows real shipped work, not just concept explorations
Fluency in a modern design tool (Figma or equivalent) and a working understanding of how the web actually renders your work
Strong typography, layout and color instincts — you can tell why a design feels generic
Comfortable presenting and defending design decisions directly to clients
Bonus: some hands-on CSS/front-end experience so your files ship close to as-designed

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
summary: Run the paid campaigns — for us and for clients — that turn ad spend into qualified leads. You own the numbers: cost per lead, conversion rate, and return on spend, not just impressions.
responsibilities: Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant platforms
Build and iterate on audience targeting, creative testing and bidding strategy
Set up conversion tracking and attribution so every dollar spent is accounted for
Report in plain numbers — cost per lead, conversion rate, revenue impact — not vanity metrics
Work directly with the content and design team to brief creative that actually performs
requirements: 2+ years running paid campaigns with a real budget and real accountability for the results
Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at a minimum
Comfortable reading and explaining a campaign's numbers without dressing them up
Understands funnels beyond the ad click — landing pages, forms, follow-up
Can work independently against a target with light day-to-day oversight

title: Content & Social Lead
summary: Own the voice of New Machine and our clients across social and content — planning, writing and shipping posts that sound like a person, not a content calendar template.
responsibilities: Plan and run monthly content calendars for New Machine and client accounts
Write captions, scripts and short-form copy that match each brand's actual voice
Direct and edit short-form video and static content alongside the design team
Track what performs and adjust the plan — not just post and hope
Manage community engagement and respond to comments/DMs in the brand's voice
requirements: A track record of growing or running social accounts with measurable engagement
Strong, adaptable writing — able to switch tone between a clinic, a real estate brand and a restaurant
Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) — you don't need to wait on someone else to cut a reel
Organized enough to run several client calendars at once without anything slipping
Comfortable giving and taking direct feedback on creative work

title: Open Application
summary: Don't see the exact role, but think you'd be a strong addition to a small, remote-first team building startups end to end? Tell us what you do and where you'd add the most value.
responsibilities: Tell us clearly what you do best and how it fits into the startup lifecycle we run — build, launch, grow
Show us real work: a project, a repo, a portfolio, a campaign — something we can look at
Be specific about how you'd want to work with a small, remote founding team
Suggest where you'd fit even if it doesn't map to a role listed here
requirements: Real, demonstrable work in your field — no need for a specific number of years
Comfortable in a remote-first, small-team environment with direct ownership and few layers
Honest about what you're good at and what you're not
Genuinely interested in the founding-team stage, not just any job
